section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section examines the role of self-efficacy in mediating the relationship between practice variability and transfer performance. It highlights that previous research has not explored the effect of practice variability on self-efficacy dimensions (intensity and generality) or the role of self-efficacy generality in transfer. The present study proposes that increased practice variability leads to greater self-efficacy generality, which in turn improves far transfer performance.
